epic.title: Redis Coordination Skill - Production Resilience & Observability
epic.description: Enhance Redis coordination skill with error recovery, partial consensus, dynamic timeouts, priority wake-ups, health checks, graceful shutdown, and comprehensive metrics export for production-grade orchestration.

phases.name: Error Recovery & Resilience
phases.description: Implement automatic retry mechanisms and dead letter queue for failed agent signals

tasks.title: Add retry mechanism to orchestrator
tasks.description: Implement --retry-count and --retry-delay parameters with exponential backoff for agent timeout recovery
acceptance: Orchestrator accepts --retry-count and --retry-delay flags
Failed agents automatically retry with exponential backoff
Retry attempts logged with timestamp and reason
Max retries honored before final failure

tasks.title: Implement dead letter queue for failed signals
tasks.description: Create DLQ pattern to capture permanently failed agent signals for debugging
acceptance: Failed signals moved to swarm:{task}:dlq:{agent} after max retries
DLQ entries include failure reason, timestamp, retry count
Add query-dlq.sh script to inspect failed signals
DLQ entries expire after 7 days (configurable TTL)

tasks.title: Update config.json with retry defaults
tasks.description: Add retry configuration section to config.json
acceptance: config.json includes retryPolicy section
Default maxRetries: 3, retryDelay: 5000ms
DLQ TTL configurable (default: 604800 seconds)

deliverables: Dead letter queue for failed signals

phases.name: Partial Consensus & Quorum
phases.description: Enable swarms to reach consensus with subset of agents (quorum-based completion)

tasks.title: Add quorum configuration to orchestrator
tasks.description: Implement --min-quorum parameter to allow partial agent completion (e.g., 6/7 agents)
acceptance: Orchestrator accepts --min-quorum parameter (e.g., '6' or '85%')
Absolute numbers and percentages both supported
Quorum calculation per loop (Loop 3 and Loop 2 separate)
Logs indicate quorum threshold and actual completion count

tasks.title: Implement timeout handling with quorum fallback
tasks.description: When agent times out, check if remaining agents meet quorum before failing
acceptance: Timeout doesn't fail orchestration if quorum met
Timed-out agents logged to DLQ
Consensus calculated only from completed agents
Warning logged when operating below full agent count

tasks.title: Add quorum validation tests
tasks.description: Test suite validating quorum-based completion scenarios
acceptance: Test: 6/7 agents complete, quorum=6 → SUCCESS
Test: 5/7 agents complete, quorum=6 → FAILURE
Test: Percentage quorum (80% of 10 agents = 8)
Test: Quorum with retry - timed-out agent retries and reaches quorum

phases.name: Dynamic Timeout Adjustment
phases.description: Per-agent timeout configuration based on agent role and task complexity

tasks.title: Design agent timeout metadata schema
tasks.description: Define how per-agent timeouts are configured in swarm metadata
acceptance: Swarm metadata supports agentTimeouts object
Format: {"researcher": 7200, "coder-1": 3600, "default": 3600}
Fallback to global timeout if agent not specified
Timeouts in seconds (converted from ms in config.json)

tasks.title: Implement per-agent timeout in orchestrator
tasks.description: Update BLPOP timeout logic to use agent-specific timeouts
acceptance: Orchestrator reads agentTimeouts from swarm metadata
Each agent BLPOP uses its configured timeout
Logs show agent-specific timeout being used
Backward compatible with global timeout if no metadata

tasks.title: Add timeout helpers and utilities
tasks.description: Create utility functions for timeout calculation and role-based defaults
acceptance: get-agent-timeout.sh utility script
Returns timeout for given agent ID from swarm metadata
Default timeouts by agent role (researcher=2h, coder=1h, reviewer=30m)
Integration example in SKILL.md

phases.name: Priority Wake-Up Queue
phases.description: Implement priority-based wake-up using Redis Sorted Sets for critical agents

tasks.title: Design priority queue wake-up mechanism
tasks.description: Replace LPUSH/BLPOP with ZADD/BZPOPMIN for priority-ordered wake-ups
acceptance: Wake messages stored in sorted set: swarm:{task}:wake-queue
Priority score: timestamp + agent priority offset
Higher priority agents (lower score) wake first
Backward compatible with existing wake mechanism

tasks.title: Implement priority-based wake in invoke-waiting-mode.sh
tasks.description: Update wake command to support --priority flag and use ZADD
acceptance: wake command accepts --priority flag (0-100, default: 50)
Lower priority number = higher urgency
ZADD adds wake message with priority score
enter command uses BZPOPMIN instead of BLPOP

tasks.title: Update orchestrator to use priority wake-ups
tasks.description: Assign priorities during iteration transitions (validators > implementers)
acceptance: Loop 2 validators wake with priority=10 (high)
Loop 3 implementers wake with priority=30 (medium)
Product owner wakes with priority=5 (critical)
Priority documented in SKILL.md with examples

phases.name: Agent Health Checks & Heartbeat
phases.description: Implement heartbeat mechanism to detect hung agents before timeout expires

tasks.title: Design heartbeat protocol
tasks.description: Define heartbeat key pattern and expected update frequency
acceptance: Heartbeat key pattern: swarm:{task}:{agent}:heartbeat
TTL-based expiry (default: 60 seconds)
Agents update heartbeat every 30 seconds during work
Orchestrator checks heartbeat before BLPOP timeout

tasks.title: Create heartbeat helper script
tasks.description: Build heartbeat.sh for agents to pulse during long-running tasks
acceptance: heartbeat.sh send --task-id --agent-id (sets TTL key)
heartbeat.sh check --task-id --agent-id (returns alive/dead)
Automatic TTL renewal (60 seconds)
Lightweight (single Redis SET command)

tasks.title: Integrate heartbeat monitoring in orchestrator
tasks.description: Check agent heartbeats periodically and fail fast if agent hung
acceptance: Orchestrator checks heartbeats every 30s during BLPOP wait
If heartbeat missing and agent not done, log warning
After 2 missed heartbeats, consider agent hung
Hung agents trigger retry or quorum fallback

phases.name: Graceful Shutdown & Cancellation
phases.description: Enable user-initiated cancellation of orchestration with proper cleanup

tasks.title: Create cancel-swarm.sh script
tasks.description: Script to publish shutdown signal to all agents in a swarm
acceptance: cancel-swarm.sh --task-id <id> [--reason <text>]
Publishes to swarm:{task}:shutdown channel
Includes reason, timestamp, and initiator metadata
Returns list of agents notified

tasks.title: Implement shutdown handling in orchestrator
tasks.description: Orchestrator subscribes to shutdown channel and exits gracefully
acceptance: Orchestrator subscribes to swarm:{task}:shutdown
On shutdown signal, logs reason and exits with code 130
Cleans up Redis keys before exit
Marks swarm metadata as 'cancelled' status

tasks.title: Add shutdown handling to waiting agents
tasks.description: Agents in waiting mode listen for shutdown and exit gracefully
acceptance: invoke-waiting-mode.sh enter subscribes to shutdown channel
Uses BLPOP on both wake and shutdown keys (multi-key)
Returns shutdown reason to caller
Agent cleanup before exit

phases.name: Metrics Export & Observability
phases.description: Comprehensive metrics export for production monitoring and debugging

tasks.title: Design metrics schema and export format
tasks.description: Define metrics to track and output format (Prometheus/OpenTelemetry compatible)
acceptance: Metrics: iteration_duration_ms, agent_latency_ms, consensus_score, retry_count, timeout_count
Labels: task_id, agent_id, loop (2/3), iteration, mode
Output formats: Prometheus text, JSON, OpenTelemetry OTLP
Metrics stored in Redis time-series (optional)

tasks.title: Implement metrics collection in orchestrator
tasks.description: Instrument orchestrator to capture metrics at key points
acceptance: Iteration start/end timestamps recorded
Agent completion latency calculated (BLPOP duration)
Consensus scores logged per iteration
Retry and timeout events counted
Metrics stored in swarm:{task}:metrics:{metric-name}

tasks.title: Create metrics-export.sh script
tasks.description: Export collected metrics in standard formats
acceptance: metrics-export.sh --task-id <id> --format <prometheus|json|otlp>
Prometheus format: counter, gauge, histogram metrics
JSON format: structured metrics with timestamps
Optional push to remote endpoint (--push-gateway)
Supports time-range filtering (--since, --until)

tasks.title: Build metrics dashboard example
tasks.description: Create example Grafana dashboard JSON for visualizing CFN Loop metrics
acceptance: Dashboard shows iteration duration trends
Panel for consensus convergence over iterations
Agent latency heatmap
Timeout and retry counts per agent
Import instructions in SKILL.md

integration: Full CFN Loop with quorum fallback (6/7 agents)

rollback.backwardCompatibility: All enhancements backward compatible with v1.4.0 orchestration

successCriteria: All 7 phases complete with passing tests
Zero breaking changes to existing CFN Loop workflows
Documentation updated with examples for each enhancement
Metrics dashboard successfully deployed and validated
